meta.analysis: Base model copies the input letter for 'ENC: x ->' and predicts a space for 'ENC(x) ='. The latent next-letter signal appears late, around L24, carried by heads L23h14 and L21h6. Latent knowledge is weak, so this generation wires the ENC trigger patterns to the error directions in late layers and amplifies the heads that already promote the next letter. The six edits vary in layer (L20-L27), mechanism (MLP down, attn.o rank-1, head scaling) and template (both formats), with small alphas to protect benchmarks.
